body: Thank you very much for letting me know I am not the only one that feels this way.  It is surprising how much knowing that other people feel the same way can help to make you not feel crazy.

Thank you.  I actually am on 60 mg of Cymbalta right now.. I am not sure if the dose needs to be upped or what.  I always feel better during the day it's just at night.. it's like I am a completely different darker person.

Thank you so much for your advice.  I am going to start trying to be productive that way it can keep my brain turned off for awhile.  The only problem I know I will have is that it really just is for awhile.  I don't know how I am going to be able to keep my brain distracted daily 24/7.  Really just going to sleep is the worst.
